questions.text: Как ответить на «Is there a sofa in the living room?», если дивана нет?

options.text: No, there isn't.
No, it isn't.
No, there aren't.

questions.explanation: Вопрос Is there...? с единственным числом — ответ No, there isn't.

options.text: The cat is on the sofa.
The cat is under the sofa.
The cat is next to the sofa.

questions.text: Какие фразы верно описывают комнату? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: There is a lamp and a clock in my room.
The books are on the shelf.
The wardrobe is next to the door.
There are a mirror.
The carpet is under on the floor.

questions.explanation: Mirror (одно) требует there is, а не are; в «under on the floor» два предлога подряд — нужен один: on the floor.

options.text: on
in
under

questions.text: My desk is ___ the window (рядом с окном).

options.text: next to
in

questions.text: Впиши предлог: The shoes are ___ the chair (под стулом).
Впиши предлог: The pencils are ___ the box (в коробке).

pairs.left: What furniture is there in the kitchen?
pairs.right: There is a table and four chairs.

pairs.left: Is there a TV in your room? (нет)
Are there any pictures on the wall? (да)

questions.explanation: What furniture — перечисляем мебель, where — называем место с предлогом, Is there / Are there — краткий ответ с there is/are.

questions.text: Как перевести «В моей комнате две полки»?

options.text: There are two shelves in my room.
There is two shelves in my room.
There are two shelfs in my room.

questions.explanation: Полок две — множественное число, поэтому there are; shelf во мн. ч. — shelves.
